findings.finding: Exact trial-registration and ISBN matches are automatic non-review duplicates even though these identifiers can identify a study or container rather than one report.
findings.required_revision: Use them as candidates or review-required evidence unless corroborated by report-level evidence; add false-merge regression tests.

findings.finding: Study membership and ReportOfStudy links can contradict after detach, merge or split, and operation evidence endpoints are not constrained.
findings.required_revision: Enforce membership-link consistency and operation-specific evidence semantics with regression tests.

findings.finding: The greater-than-64-record blocking path is not proven complete relative to the exhaustive matcher and can miss high-Jaccard candidates.
findings.required_revision: Implement completeness-preserving candidate generation and blocked-versus-exhaustive differential tests.

findings.finding: Truncated BibTeX and EndNote records, and parenthesized BibTeX entries, can be silently discarded rather than quarantined.
findings.required_revision: Quarantine all non-empty unconsumed input with line spans and test parenthesized or explicitly rejected syntax.

findings.finding: The study-linkage gold fixture is declared but not consumed by an executable metric path.
findings.required_revision: Execute the linkage fixture through declared metrics before re-panel.

claim_ceiling: Compiler-backed deterministic behavior only. No external validation, methodological adequacy or general deduplication/linkage performance is established.
